units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 6) procurement of works or services that can be performed or provided only by an executive authority acting within its powers, by the State Space Corporation Roscosmos, by a State institution or State unitary enterprise, or by a joint-stock company wholly owned by the Russian Federation, whose respective powers are established by federal laws or regulatory legal acts of the President or Government of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 6.1) procurement by executive bodies of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation and State institutions of that constituent entity (municipal institutions of municipalities within it) of medicines, specialized therapeutic food products, medical devices, consumables and disinfectants, together with storage and delivery services for those goods and repair and maintenance of medical devices, from a State unitary enterprise of that constituent entity or a joint-stock company wholly owned by it;
units.label: Point 6.1 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 7) conclusion of a contract for Russian weapons and military equipment that have no Russian equivalents and are produced by a sole manufacturer, with a supplier entered in the register of sole suppliers of those weapons and military equipment. The Government of the Russian Federation shall establish the procedure for maintaining that register and forming their prices. The State contract for their supply shall be concluded at a price determined under that pricing procedure;
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 8) provision of water supply, wastewater disposal, heat supply, municipal solid waste management, management of hazard classes I and II waste, gas supply (excluding sales of liquefied gas), connection to utility infrastructure networks, and storage and import (export) of narcotic drugs and psychotropic substances;
units.label: Point 8 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 9) procurement of goods, works or services where urgent or emergency medical care is needed, or as a result of an accident or force majeure, to prevent an emergency (where a high-alert regime has been introduced for the management bodies and forces of the unified State emergency prevention and response system) and/or respond to an emergency, or to provide humanitarian aid. The contracting authority may procure goods, works or services in the quantities or volumes needed for that medical care, as a consequence of that accident or force majeure, for emergency prevention and/or response, or for humanitarian aid, where using competitive methods requiring time would be impractical;
units.label: Point 9 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 10) supply of cultural valuables, including museum objects and collections, rare and valuable publications, manuscripts and archival documents (including copies) of historical, artistic or other cultural significance, intended to augment the Museum Fund of the Russian Federation, the Archival Fund of the Russian Federation, the national library collection, film and photographic collections and similar collections;
units.label: Point 10 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 11) production of goods, performance of works or provision of services by an institution and/or enterprise of the penal correction system, including exclusively for the needs of organizations, enterprises, institutions and bodies of that system, in accordance with the list of goods, works and services approved by the Government of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 11 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 12) conclusion by a penal institution of a contract for supply of goods for State needs when it acquires raw materials, materials and components to produce goods, perform works or provide services in order to employ convicted persons under agreements with legal entities, provided that those acquisitions are financed from the funds provided for in those agreements;
units.label: Point 12 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 13) procurement for contracting authorities’ needs of literary and artistic works by specified authors (excluding acquisition of films for distribution), rights to such works, performances by specified performers, rights to such performances, phonograms of specified producers and rights to those phonograms, where a single person holds the exclusive rights or exclusive licences to those works, performances or phonograms;
units.label: Point 13 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 14) procurement of printed or electronic publications by specified authors, including the software, hardware and information protection tools used in them, from their publishers where those publishers hold exclusive rights or exclusive licences to use the publications, and services providing access to those electronic publications to support the activities of State and municipal educational organizations, State and municipal libraries and State scientific organizations;
units.label: Point 14 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 15) conclusion of a contract for admission to a zoo, theatre, cinema, concert, circus, museum, exhibition or sporting event;
units.label: Point 15 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 16) conclusion of a contract for services enabling participation in an event held for the needs of several contracting authorities, with a supplier (contractor, service provider) selected under this Federal Law by the contracting authority organizing that event;
units.label: Point 16 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 17) conclusion by a theatre; an institution engaged in concert or theatrical activities, including a performing group (dance group, choir, orchestra or ensemble); a television and radio broadcasting institution; a circus, museum, house of culture, palace of culture, house or centre of folk creativity, house or centre of crafts, club, educational organization, zoo, planetarium, culture and recreation park, nature reserve, botanical garden, national park, nature park or landscape park, of a contract with a specified individual to create a literary or artistic work, or with a specified individual or legal entity engaged in concert or theatrical activities, including a performing group (dance group, choir, orchestra or ensemble), for a performance, or with an individual or legal entity to manufacture and supply scenery (including for stage and audiovisual effects), stage furniture, stage costumes (including headwear and footwear), materials needed to create scenery (including for stage and audiovisual effects) and costumes, theatrical or concert props, musical instruments, imitation props, make-up, wigs and hairpieces, and theatrical puppets needed for the creation and/or performance of works by those organizations;
units.label: Point 17 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 18) conclusion of a contract for services selling admission tickets and season tickets to theatrical and entertainment, cultural and educational, and leisure entertainment events, and excursion tickets and excursion vouchers that are strict-accountability forms;
units.label: Point 18 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 19) conclusion of a contract for services of authorial control over preparation of design documentation for a capital construction facility, authorial supervision of its construction, reconstruction or major repairs by the respective authors, or technical and authorial supervision by the project authors of works to preserve a cultural heritage site (historical and cultural monuments) of the peoples of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 19 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 20) conclusion of contracts for services supporting visits by heads of foreign States or governments, heads of international organizations, parliamentary delegations, government delegations and delegations of foreign States, including hotel and transport services, operation of computer, office and sound equipment (including for simultaneous interpretation), and catering;
units.label: Point 20 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 21) conclusion of contracts for goods, works and services supporting the activities of persons subject to State protection, including off-site events held by the President of the Russian Federation, the chambers of the Federal Assembly of the Russian Federation and the Government of the Russian Federation, including everyday support, hotel and transport services, operation of computer, office and sound equipment (including for simultaneous interpretation), sanitary and epidemiological welfare, and catering (including safe food);
units.label: Point 21 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 22) conclusion by a management company of an apartment building management contract on the basis of a decision of the general meeting of owners of premises in that building or an open tender held by a local self-government body under housing legislation, where premises in the apartment building are privately, State- or municipally owned;
units.label: Point 22 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 23) conclusion of a contract for works or services involving maintenance and operational inspection of buildings and structures, preservation of cultural heritage sites (historical and cultural monuments) of the peoples of the Russian Federation, maintenance and repair of common property in a building or one or more non-residential premises owned by the contracting authority, assigned to it under the right of economic management or operational administration, or transferred to it on another lawful basis under Russian legislation, and cold and/or hot water supply, wastewater disposal, electricity, heat and gas supply, security services or municipal solid waste management, where those works or services are provided to another person or persons using non-residential premises in the building containing the contracting authority’s premises held under ownership, economic management, operational administration or another lawful basis under Russian legislation. If it is impossible to contract directly with the contractor or provider of those works or services, the contracting authority may conclude a contract with the person who has contracted for them under Russian legislation, providing for payment of their cost in proportion to the area of the premises owned by or assigned or lawfully transferred to the contracting authority under those rights as a share of the building’s total area;
units.label: Point 23 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 24) conclusion of a contract under Article 77, paragraph 2(2) and paragraphs 3 and 4, of this Federal Law where the supplier (contractor, service provider) selection has been declared unsuccessful under this Federal Law. The contract shall comply with paragraph 5 of this Article;
units.label: Point 24 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 25) conclusion of a contract under Article 52, paragraph 2(6), paragraph 3(6), paragraph 4(2), and paragraphs 5, 6 and 8, of this Federal Law where the supplier (contractor, service provider) selection has been declared unsuccessful under this Federal Law. The contract shall comply with paragraph 5 of this Article;
units.label: Point 25 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 25.1) - 25.3) Repealed from 1 July 2020. — Federal Law of 27.12.2019 No. 449-FZ;
units.label: Point 25.1 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 26) conclusion of a contract for services connected with an employee’s official business trip, participation in festivals, concerts, performances and similar cultural events (including tours) on the basis of invitations to those events, or participation in official physical culture and sporting events. Such services include travel to and from the business-trip destination or event venue, rental of accommodation, transport services and catering;
units.label: Point 26 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 27) Repealed from 1 January 2014. — Federal Law of 28.12.2013 No. 396-FZ;
units.label: Point 27 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 28) procurement of medicines intended for prescription to a patient on medical grounds (individual intolerance or vital indications), by a medical commission decision recorded in the patient’s medical records and the commission’s register. The contracting authority may conclude a supply contract under this point for an amount not exceeding one and a half million roubles. The quantity procured must not exceed that needed for the patient during the time required to procure the medicines through an electronic request for quotations under Article 24(10)(2)(г) of this Federal Law or through closed competitive methods. A single contract under this point may not cover medicines intended for prescription to two or more patients. The medical commission’s decision must be entered, together with the contract concluded under this point, in the register of contracts provided for in Article 103 of this Federal Law. Personal data must be anonymized as required by Federal Law No. 152-FZ of 27 July 2006 “On Personal Data”;
units.label: Point 28 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 28.1) Not applicable under Federal Law No. 46-FZ of 08.03.2022; repealed by Federal Law No. 318-FZ of 08.08.2024;
units.label: Point 28.1 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 29) conclusion of an energy supply contract or electricity sale and purchase contract with a guaranteeing electricity supplier;
units.label: Point 29 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 30) procurement of goods, works and services to prepare and conduct elections or a referendum or support the activities of an election commission or referendum commission, except in the cases provided for in Article 1(2)(6), (7) and (9) of this Federal Law. The Government of the Russian Federation shall approve, on the proposal of the Central Election Commission of the Russian Federation, the list of goods, works and services that may be procured under this point;
units.label: Point 30 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 30.1) Not applicable from 1 January 2021 under Federal Law No. 27-FZ of 27.02.2020; repealed by Federal Law No. 318-FZ of 08.08.2024;
units.label: Point 30.1 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 31) conclusion of a contract to acquire a non-residential building, structure, facility or premises for federal, constituent-entity or municipal needs, as designated in a decision to prepare and implement budget investments or grant subsidies for capital investments to acquire real property into State or municipal ownership, adopted in the procedure established respectively by the Government of the Russian Federation, the highest executive body of the constituent entity or the local administration;
units.label: Point 31 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 32) rental of a non-residential building, structure, facility, premises or land plot, and rental of residential premises in a foreign State by contracting authorities operating in a foreign State;
units.label: Point 32 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 33) conclusion of a contract for teaching services or excursion guide services provided by individuals;
units.label: Point 33 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 34) conclusion by a federal executive body of a contract with a foreign organization for treatment of a citizen of the Russian Federation outside its territory, in accordance with rules established by the Government of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 34 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 35) conclusion by organizations engaged in educational activities and recognized under education legislation as federal or regional innovation sites of contracts for supply of equipment (including its technical operation) and computer software needed to introduce scientific and technical results and results of intellectual activity, with the holder of exclusive rights to that equipment and software, using funds allocated for development of innovation infrastructure in the education system;
units.label: Point 35 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 36) conclusion by a budget-funded institution or a State or municipal unitary enterprise of a contract whose subject matter is the issuance of an independent guarantee;
units.label: Point 36 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 37) procurement of folk arts and crafts products of recognized artistic merit, specimens of which have been registered in the procedure established by the federal executive body authorized by the Government of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 37 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 38) conclusion by executive authorities or local self-government bodies of contracts to acquire residential premises meeting the conditions for classification as standard housing established by the authorized federal executive body, with a legal entity that has concluded an integrated territorial development agreement under the Urban Planning Code of the Russian Federation providing for construction of standard housing, at the price and within the time limits specified in that agreement, with provision for conclusion of State and/or municipal contracts;
units.label: Point 38 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 39) conclusion by executive authorities or local self-government bodies of contracts to acquire residential premises meeting the conditions for classification as standard housing established by the authorized federal executive body, with a person that has concluded, in the procedure and on the terms provided for by Federal Law No. 161-FZ of 24 July 2008 “On Promoting Housing Construction, Creation of Tourism Infrastructure and Other Territorial Development”, one of the following agreements: gratuitous use of a land plot for construction of standard housing, comprehensive territorial development or integrated territorial development including construction of standard housing; lease of a land plot for construction of standard housing, comprehensive territorial development or integrated territorial development including construction of standard housing; or lease of a land plot for construction of the minimum required volume of standard housing, comprehensive territorial development or integrated territorial development including that minimum volume and other housing construction. The price and time limits shall be those specified in the relevant agreement, provided it envisages conclusion of State and/or municipal contracts;
units.label: Point 39 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 40) procurement of goods, works and services to provide the foreign intelligence bodies of the Russian Federation with means of intelligence activity. The head of the relevant foreign intelligence body shall approve the list of goods, works and services that may be procured under this point;
units.label: Point 40 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 41) procurement of goods, works and services to provide federal security service bodies with means of counterintelligence and counter-terrorism activity. The head of the federal executive body responsible for security shall approve the list of goods, works and services that may be procured under this point;
units.label: Point 41 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 42) conclusion by the federal executive body responsible for producing official statistical information on social, economic, demographic, environmental and other societal processes in the Russian Federation, and by its territorial bodies, of contracts with individuals for collection and processing of primary statistical data during federal statistical observations in the Russian Federation under the legislation on official statistical accounting. That federal executive body shall establish the volume of work to be performed and the contract price, calculated on the basis of the remuneration terms for individuals engaged under contracts to collect and process primary statistical data during federal statistical observations in the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 42 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 43) Repealed from 31 December 2017. — Federal Law of 31.12.2017 No. 503-FZ;
units.label: Point 43 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 44) procurement by State and municipal libraries, organizations engaged in educational activities, and State and municipal scientific organizations of services granting access to information in foreign documentary, bibliographic, abstracting and full-text databases and specialized databases of international scientific citation indexes, from operators of those databases included in the list approved by the Government of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 44 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 45) procurement by State and municipal libraries, organizations engaged in educational activities, and State and municipal scientific organizations of services granting access to information in foreign documentary, bibliographic, abstracting and full-text databases and specialized databases of international scientific citation indexes, from national libraries and federal libraries specializing in science. The price of such a sole-supplier (contractor, service provider) contract shall be determined in the procedure established by the Government of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 45 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 46) procurement of goods, works and services using funds allocated for operational search activities. The head of the relevant federal executive body authorized to conduct operational search activities under Federal Law No. 144-FZ of 12 August 1995 “On Operational Search Activities” shall approve the list of goods, works and services that may be procured under this point;
units.label: Point 46 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 47) procurement, at regulated prices and subject to the specific rules provided for in Article 111.3 of this Federal Law, of goods whose production has been established or modernized and/or mastered in the Russian Federation under a special investment contract;
units.label: Point 47 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 48) procurement, at regulated prices and subject to the specific rules in Article 111.4 of this Federal Law, of goods whose production has been established, modernized or mastered under a contract with reciprocal investment obligations, and/or services provided using property (immovable property, or technologically linked immovable and movable property) created or reconstructed under such a contract. Only contracting authorities of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation whose highest executive body adopted the act on the basis of which the procurement resulting in the contract with reciprocal investment obligations was conducted, and contracting authorities of municipalities within that constituent entity, may conclude a contract under this point. Only the legal entity with which that contract with reciprocal investment obligations was concluded may be the sole supplier of goods or sole service provider;
units.label: Point 48 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 49) procurement by the federal executive body authorized by the Government of the Russian Federation of works to manufacture excise stamps for tobacco products imported into the Russian Federation, at prices (tariffs) established under the legislation of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 49 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 50) procurement of transport services and related supplementary services where military transport by rail, sea, river, air or road is necessary in the event of a threat to the military security of the Russian Federation and/or to support the participation of its Armed Forces and other troops in operations to maintain or restore international peace and security outside the Russian Federation, in accordance with generally recognized principles and rules of international law and the international treaties of the Russian Federation, in the procedure established by its Government;
units.label: Point 50 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 51) procurement of legal services to protect the interests of the Russian Federation in foreign and international courts and arbitration proceedings and before authorities of foreign States;
units.label: Point 51 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 52) procurement of goods, works and services by State protection bodies to implement State protection measures. The head of the federal executive body responsible for State protection shall approve the list of goods, works and services that may be procured under this point;
units.label: Point 52 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 53) conclusion by State authorities of the Russian Federation, State authorities of its constituent entities and local self-government bodies of contracts for rating services provided by legal entities recognized as credit rating agencies under Russian legislation, and by foreign legal entities conducting rating activities outside the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 53 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 54) procurement of works to modernize information systems providing legal information support for the chambers of the Federal Assembly of the Russian Federation, and services to support those systems;
units.label: Point 54 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 55) conclusion of a contract for services to manufacture forms of documents identifying citizens of the Russian Federation within and outside its territory; forms of documents identifying foreign citizens or stateless persons issued in the Russian Federation in the cases established by its legislation; civil status registration certificate forms; forms of temporary documents identifying a Russian citizen and entitling that citizen to enter (return to) the Russian Federation; and forms of documents for foreign citizens and stateless persons to enter and leave the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 55 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 56) procurement of goods, works and services by the federal executive body responsible for developing and implementing State defence policy, its subordinate State institutions and State unitary enterprises, other federal executive bodies listed by the Government of the Russian Federation, and their subordinate State institutions and State unitary enterprises, for conducting the special military operation and performing special tasks to ensure State defence and security, including counter-terrorism. The heads of those federal executive bodies shall approve the lists of goods, works and services that may be procured under this point;
units.label: Point 56 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 57) acquisition of a building, structure, facility, non-residential premises or land plot as a result of bidding that is mandatory under land legislation, the legislation of the Russian Federation on enforcement proceedings or Federal Law No. 127-FZ of 26 October 2002 “On Insolvency (Bankruptcy)”;
units.label: Point 57 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 58) procurement of material assets released from the State material reserve;
units.label: Point 58 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 59) procurement of goods, works and services to support a diplomatic mission, consular institution or trade mission of the Russian Federation, its mission to international (interstate or intergovernmental) organizations, or an office and/or representative of a federal executive body performing functions connected with that body’s activities outside the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 59 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 60) procurement of sports clothing and equipment, apparatus, inventory and gear needed for preparation and participation of Russia’s Olympic and Paralympic teams and the national sports teams of the Russian Federation in international sports competitions under the Unified Calendar Plan of Interregional, All-Russian and International Physical Culture and Sports Events;
units.label: Point 60 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 61) conclusion of a contract for services to train cosmonauts, organize and support spacecraft launches and control them in flight, and create space technology (development, manufacture and testing);
units.label: Point 61 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 62) conclusion of a contract for storage services for material assets of the State material reserve;
units.label: Point 62 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 63) rental of residential premises, including abroad, by federal executive bodies or federal State bodies in which federal law provides for military service, or by bodies or institutions authorized by them, to provide the premises to military personnel and family members living with them under the legislation of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 63 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 2. No later than one working day following entry in the register of contracts concluded by contracting authorities of information on a sole-supplier (contractor, service provider) contract in the cases specified in paragraph 1(6), (6.1), (9), (34) and (50) of this Article, the contracting authority shall use the unified information system to send a notification of conclusion of the contract, justifying that case and identifying the provisions of this Article on which the contract is based. For procurement for federal needs, it shall send the notification to the federal executive body authorized for procurement oversight or to the State defence order oversight body; for constituent-entity needs, to the constituent entity’s executive body authorized for procurement oversight; and for municipal needs, to the local self-government body authorized for procurement oversight. If, in procurement under paragraph 1(6), (6.1), (9), (34) and (50) of this Article, the contract must under this Federal Law be entered in the separate register of contracts provided for in Article 103(7) of this Federal Law, the contracting authority shall send the relevant procurement oversight body a notification no later than one working day following conclusion of the contract, justifying the case and identifying the provisions of this Article on which the contract is based, with a copy of the signed contract attached.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider)
units.text: 3. No notice of procurement from a sole supplier (contractor, service provider) is required.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 93
